run_episode_inference: run inference on a miniwob episode using a model server and output an HTML visualization
create_miniwob_env: create a MiniWobEnv instance with a miniwob URL and cursor directory for browser automation
get_stub_server: get a gRPC stub to connect to a pix2act model server by BNS address
get_single_beam_prediction: get a single prediction beam from the model server given a screenshot PNG
filter_cycle_predictions: filter predictions using a CycleChecker to avoid repeating the same screenshot-action pairs
write_steps_to_html: write episode steps including screenshots, cursor state, actions, and metadata to an HTML file
